columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the customer who placed the order

columns.name: product_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the product ordered

columns.name: product_category
columns.description: Category the product belongs to, e.g. Electronics, Apparel

columns.name: order_status
columns.description: Current status of the order, e.g. PLACED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED

columns.name: payment_method
columns.description: Payment method used, e.g. CREDIT_CARD, PAYPAL, COD

columns.name: order_date
columns.description: Calendar date the order was placed, used as the partition column

columns.name: order_updated_at
columns.description: Last time this order record changed; used as the incremental watermark column
